tips.en: Does it work with my phone?
as long as your phone is unlocked

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: Hi. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: I'd like to buy a SIM card for tourists, please.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: Sure. This one has ten gigabytes for fourteen days.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Does it work with my phone?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: Yes, as long as your phone is unlocked.
turns.ko: 네. 폰 잠금이 풀려 있으면 됩니다.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Perfect. I'll take it. Can you help me put it in?
turns.ko: 완벽해요. 이거로 할게요. 끼워 넣는 거 도와주시겠어요?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: Of course. Just restart your phone after this.
turns.ko: 당연히요. 이거 하고 폰만 다시 켜 주세요.
